projects.name: ChronoState Engine
projects.tagline: Deterministic state replay and time-travel debugger for AI agent workflows
projects.description: ChronoState Engine captures atomic state transitions across multi-agent pipelines with zero execution penalty. It enables deterministic step-by-step playback, microsecond delta rollback, and automated anomaly localization across LLM tool executions.
projects.differentiator: Uses copy-on-write memory snapshots achieving 50x less RAM usage than traditional state-history trees with zero runtime latency penalty.

projects.name: HyperAgent Orchestrator
projects.tagline: Autonomous multi-model routing engine with sub-50ms latency
projects.description: A lightweight orchestration framework that intelligently routes user prompts across Claude, GPT-4, and specialized local LLMs. It features zero-config streaming, automatic fallback handling, semantic caching, and full observability. Built for high-throughput production environments requiring ultra-low overhead.
projects.stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Fastify, Redis, Arena SDK
projects.differentiator: Unlike heavy frameworks like LangChain, HyperAgent has zero runtime dependencies, a 12KB footprint, and sub-millisecond dispatch overhead with predictive model pre-warming.

projects.name: DelQuro Files Pro
projects.tagline: Single-file build tracker with live AI code receiver and 120-word card synthesizer
projects.description: The premier build log and project tracker for AI-augmented developers. Features zero-install single-file portability, live webhook code intake from any AI assistant, automatic 120-word card synthesis, and native multi-platform linking across Arena.ai, GitHub, Emergent.sh, and Base44.com.
projects.stack: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Node.js, REST API
projects.differentiator: Bridges the gap between AI code generation and project management by providing an instant webhook receiver that turns raw AI code into structured, shareable cards in one click.

inbox.name: OmniVector Engine
inbox.tagline: Quantized real-time vector search for resource-constrained edge devices
inbox.description: OmniVector Engine is an ultra-compact vector search engine built for edge computing environments. It implements 1-bit binary quantization, hierarchical navigable small-world indexing, and hardware SIMD acceleration. Achieves sub-millisecond retrieval on ARM devices.
inbox.differentiator: Consumes 94% less RAM than standard float32 vector indexes while retaining 98.2% top-10 recall accuracy.

inbox.name: VectorFlow Neural Indexer
inbox.tagline: Ultra-fast approximate nearest neighbor vector indexing engine
inbox.description: VectorFlow is a high-performance vector similarity search engine implemented in Python and Rust. It provides sub-5ms cosine similarity lookups across millions of high-dimensional embeddings. Designed as an embedded library with zero external cluster requirements.
inbox.differentiator: Runs completely in-process with zero network hops, delivering 10x lower latency than Pinecone or Weaviate for embedded AI workloads.
